entities.name: Donal
entities.description: Human Wizard of Innistrad, devout worshipper of Avacyn who now lives among birds.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel worshipped by Donal; her betrayal and unmaking left him lost.

events.summary: Avacyn's betrayal and unmaking leave Donal lost, and he sets off on a pilgrimage.
events.quote: He set off on a pilgrimage in search of deeper meaning.

events.summary: Donal wakes in a forest clearing surrounded by mortal and spirit birds and feels peace for the first time since the unmaking.
events.quote: he found himself surrounded by both mortal and spirit

events.summary: Donal decides to live among the birds.
events.quote: He has since decided to live among the birds

relations.note: Donal was a devout worshipper of Avacyn.
